title: Name the speed
prompt: The robot's drive code works, but what is 250? Give it a name: create a constant `SPEED` equal to 250 and use it in place of the bare number. The results stay the same.
hints: A constant is made with the word const on its own line above the return.
Then the return line becomes `SPEED * seconds`; 250 should appear only once in your code.

docs.name: const NAME = value
docs.what: Declares a named value that never changes. Written in CAPITALS by convention.
